title: Page Object Model for UI Automation

scenes.line1: How do you keep test code clean?
scenes.line2: What is the Page Object Model?
scenes.say: Want your UI tests to stay clean and easy to update? Let's talk about the Page Object Model.

scenes.label: POM
scenes.sub: Encapsulate page elements and actions in classes or modules.
scenes.say: The Page Object Model means you wrap page elements and actions into their own class or module.
You get three wins: reusable code, readable tests, and easy updates when the UI changes.
Here's a LoginPage class. All the login logic sits in one spot, so any UI changes are easy to fix.

scenes.question: What does POM help with most?
scenes.right: Makes tests easier to maintain and update
scenes.say: Don't mix up speed with maintainability. POM is all about making updates simple and keeping tests organized.
